abstract: Over the past two decades, the use of well-validated, guideline-based strategies resulted in high cure rates in patients with germ-cell cancer (GCC) often despite widespread metastatic disease at initial presentation. Yet, about 30 % of patients diagnosed with metastatic disease corresponding to about 5-10 % of GCC patients overall will experience disease progression or recurrence at some time point of their disease with the need for salvage treatment. Salvage treatment is more complex and less well validated than first-line treatment: Its rare patient cohorts are more heterogeneous and prognostic factors impact more compared to other treatment scenarios. In patients with metastatic GCC, there are several scenarios in which first-line treatment strategies can fail (Fig. 1). Prior to initiation of any salvage treatment, several considerations have to be made, which will be addressed in this review: verification that first-line treatment has indeed failed, estimation of the adequacy and the effectiveness of first-line treatment, search for metastatic sites and extent of disease recurrence, assessment of known prognostic factors and finally the choice of the optimal salvage strategy taking into account the aforementioned variables. High-dose chemotherapy will be a rational choice for many patients in need of salvage treatment, but careful patient selection will be required to avoid overtreatment and unnecessary long-term toxicity.
abstract_ja: 過去20年間、ガイドラインに基づいた確立された治療戦略により、初診時に広範な転移を有する患者を含め、胚細胞腫瘍（GCC）患者の高い治癒率が得られてきた。しかしながら、転移性疾患と診断された患者の約30%、すなわちGCC患者全体の約5〜10%は、病勢進行または再発を経験し、救済治療が必要となる。救済治療は初回治療よりも複雑で十分な検証が乏しく、その稀な患者コホートは不均一であり、他の治療場面と比べて予後因子の影響が大きい。転移性GCCの患者では、初回治療戦略が奏効しない複数の場面がある（図1）。救済治療を開始する前に、いくつかの検討が必要であり、本総説ではそれらを扱う。すなわち、初回治療が実際に失敗したことの確認、初回治療の妥当性と有効性の評価、転移部位と再発の範囲の検索、既知の予後因子の評価、そして前述の変数を考慮した最適な救済戦略の選択である。大量化学療法は、救済治療を必要とする多くの患者にとって合理的な選択肢となるが、過剰治療と不必要な長期毒性を避けるため、慎重な患者選択が必要である。
